description: Perennial flowering plants with sweet, indigo-colored berries. Blueberry plants are usually erect, prostrate shrubs that range in height from 10cm to 4m high, depending on the cultivar.
sowing_method: Plant plants into soil or pots.

data_sources.notes: growth_habit='upright' inferred by Ollama (no Trefle growth_habit data (no cached match or null field)); reasoning: Blueberry plants are described as erect shrubs that grow taller than wide.
life_cycle='perennial' inferred by Ollama; reasoning: Blueberries are typically grown as perennial shrubs in home gardens in Belgium.
life_cycle_years=15 inferred by Ollama; reasoning: Blueberry bushes typically start to decline in productivity after about 10-20 years.
edible_parts=['fruit'] inferred by Ollama; reasoning: Blueberries are primarily grown for their sweet, edible berries.

is_edible corrected from false to true (GitHub issue #165): edible_parts=['fruit'] was already populated, a direct contradiction with is_edible=false, and no is_toxic flag or toxicity_notes explained the discrepancy - a full-dataset audit found this affecting 120 plants (grown from an earlier 25-plant spot-check once backlog #133's edible_parts backfill widened coverage), all of them unambiguous real food/herb/fruit crops.
